sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: obtaining a new credential, permits and exams
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Real ID compliance since a fixed date and the free ID card rule are stated on the credential-overview page [A01]; the Real ID document list itself lives in Appendix A and is not restated here.
The transfer rules for an out-of-state license expired under or over the five-year mark come from one page and are kept as separate blocks so they are not merged [A02].
The vehicle rejection list for the skills exam is introduced as examples, not a complete list, so learners are not told it is exhaustive [A06].
The manual does not say whether the knowledge exam is offered in languages other than English or orally; nothing is asserted about that here (verify IN-NEWCRED-D-LANG).
Phone numbers, websites and booking windows are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic [A05].

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical pages 6 to 11 of the Indiana Driver's Manual describe the knowledge exam as multiple-choice and computer-based but say nothing about languages offered or oral or assisted versions; confirm with the BMV knowledge exam page before any claim is shown.
